log_file_path.description: Path to the log file for Dante SOCKS server

log_output_method.description: Where to log output: stderr, syslog, stdout, or a file path

internal_ip.description: IP address for the server to bind to internally

internal_port.description: Port number for the server to listen on

external_ip.description: External IP address used for outgoing connections

socks_methods.description: Space-separated list of acceptable SOCKS authentication methods

client_methods.description: Space-separated list of acceptable client authentication methods

privileged_user.description: User ID used when requiring privileges

unprivileged_user.description: User ID used for normal unprivileged operations

internal_network.description: CIDR notation of the internal network considered trusted
